title: The plugin reads its own trail back
description: The largest lever in the 3.0 analysis and the least defined, taken whole by the operator: an agent that needs one old task reads the whole plan; the doctor reports no pattern; init proposes gates from the tree alone; and a retry brief carries only the last attempt. Each of the four states its own done before it is started, because 'the plugin learns' is not a verifiable sentence.
desiredOutcome: One query verb answers for a named task, bug or phase without loading the whole manifest, and the bytes it reads are the measurement; the doctor names a pattern this repo's own trail actually holds, and says nothing on a repo with no history; init's proposed gates differ measurably between a repo with history and the same repo without it; and a third attempt's brief carries what the two before it cost.
